about.notAffiliated: Plex is a trademark of Plex, Inc. Wicaby is an unofficial client, not affiliated with or endorsed by Plex.

errors.remoteNeedsPass: Playing from this server away from its network needs a Plex Pass (yours or the owner’s) or a Remote Watch Pass. On the server’s network it still works.
errors.lowerQuality: The server refuses this quality remotely. Pick a lower quality in the Quality menu.
errors.fileUnavailable: This item’s file cannot be found on the Plex server.
errors.castNeedsRelay: To cast from Plex, turn on the cast relay in Settings: Wicaby never puts the Plex token in an address.
errors.dlnaNeedsDirectPlay: This TV can't play this file as is. Wicaby has Plex convert videos to HLS only, which DLNA TVs don't play: cast to a Chromecast, or play it here.
errors.secureRequired: This Plex server requires a secure connection, and no https address answers.
errors.relink: The Plex account is no longer linked: link it again with a code.
errors.noAccess: This profile has no access to this Plex server.

pass.markers: No Skip intro button: intro and credits detection is a Plex Pass feature of the server.
pass.transcode: This server has no Plex Pass: transcoding runs without hardware acceleration and may be slow.

link.title: Plex account
link.body: Link your Plex account with a code: your Plex servers, and the ones shared with you, join Wicaby.
link.lead: On a phone or a computer, open plex.tv/link and enter this code, or scan the QR code:
link.waiting: Waiting for the code to be entered on plex.tv…
link.linked: {count, plural, one {# Plex server added.} other {# Plex servers added.}}
link.noServers: This Plex account has access to no server.

account.passOn: Plex Pass active on this account.
account.passOff: Without Plex Pass on its owner’s account, a server offers no live TV, no “Skip intro” buttons and no hardware transcoding; playing away from its network needs a Plex Pass or a Remote Watch Pass.
account.unofficial: Wicaby is an unofficial client, not affiliated with Plex.

login.pinLead: Enter the PIN of this Plex profile.
login.confirmBody: This server only answers at {address}, an unencrypted address. Wicaby sends your Plex access there only if you agree: accept only on the server’s network.
